newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-West Indies win toss and bat v Western Australia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-West Indies win toss and bat v Western Australia.

text.p: West Indies won the toss and chose to bat in a rain-shortened limited overs match against Western Australia on Wednesday.
Rain forced umpires to shorten the match from a scheduled 50 overs to 47 overs per side, with the start delayed by over an hour.
West Indies will be led by star batsman Brian Lara after tour captain Courtney Walsh decided to sit out the match.
Roland Holder was named as twelfth man for West Indies while Sean Carey will carry the drinks for Western Australia.
West Indies - Robert Samuels, Adrian Griffith, Brian Lara (captain), Shivnarine Chanderpaul, Carl Hooper, Jimmy Adams, Courtney Browne, Ian Bishop, Curtly Ambrose, Nixon McLean, Patterson Thompson.
Western Australia - Mark Lavender, Mike Hussey, Damien Martyn, Justin Langer, Rob Baker, Ryan Campbell, Brendon Julian (captain), Kade Harvey, Mark Atkinson, Jamie Stewart, Jo Angel.
